passages.text: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was sixteen years old.
All the people of Judah took Uzziah.
They made Uzziah king.
Uzziah became king instead of his father Amaziah.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֞וּ כָּל־ עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־ עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וְה֕וּא בֶּן־ שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֣יכוּ אֹת֔וֹ תַּ֖חַת אָבִ֥יו אֲמַצְיָֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Uzziah was the one who rebuilt Eloth and restored it to Judah after King Amaziah rested with his fathers.
passages.sermon: Uzziah became king after his father Amaziah died.\r\nUzziah rebuilt the city of Eloth.\r\nUzziah gave Eloth back to Judah.
passages.original: ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־ אֵיל֔וֹת וַיְשִׁיבֶ֖הָ לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֥י שְׁכַֽב־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם־ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃פ

passages.text: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah became king when he was sixteen years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for fifty-two years.
His mother was Jecoliah.
Jecoliah was from Jerusalem.
passages.original: בֶּן־ שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְכִילְיָה מִן־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
Uzziah did what was right.
He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
Amaziah was Uzziah’s father.
Amaziah also did what was right.
Uzziah acted just as his father Amaziah had done.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: He sought God throughout the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. And as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king in Jerusalem.
Zechariah lived during Uzziah’s reign.
Zechariah understood visions from God.
Uzziah sought God during Zechariah’s days.
Zechariah taught Uzziah to fear God.
Uzziah continued to seek the LORD.
God made Uzziah successful as long as he sought the LORD.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בִּימֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֔הוּ הַמֵּבִ֖ין בִּרְאֹ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבִימֵי֙ דָּרְשׁ֣וֹ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה הִצְלִיח֖וֹ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס

passages.text: Uzziah went out to wage war against the Philistines, and he tore down the walls of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod. Then he built cities near Ashdod and among the Philistines.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
Uzziah went out to fight the Philistines.
He attacked the Philistines.
He tore down the wall of Gath.
He tore down the wall of Jabneh.
He tore down the wall of Ashdod.
He built cities near Ashdod.
He built cities among the Philistines.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ וַיִּלָּ֣חֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיִּפְרֹ֞ץ אֶת־ ח֣וֹמַת גַּ֗ת וְאֵת֙ חוֹמַ֣ת יַבְנֵ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת אַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וַיִּבְנֶ֣ה עָרִ֔ים בְּאַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וּבַפְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: God helped him against the Philistines, against the Arabs living in Gur-baal, and against the Meunites.
passages.sermon:
God helped Uzziah.
God helped him fight the Philistines.
God helped him fight the Arabs who lived in Gur-baal.
God helped him fight the Meunites.
passages.original: וַיַּעְזְרֵ֨הוּ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֜ים עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים וְעַל־ הָעַרְבִיִּים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בְּגוּר־ בָּ֖עַל וְהַמְּעוּנִֽים׃

passages.text: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt, for he had become exceedingly powerful.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was the king of Judah.
The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah.
Uzziah became very powerful.
His fame spread far.
People heard of him all the way to the border of Egypt.
passages.original: וַיִּתְּנ֧וּ הָֽעַמּוֹנִ֛ים מִנְחָ֖ה לְעֻזִּיָּ֑הוּ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁמוֹ֙ עַד־ לְב֣וֹא מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י הֶחֱזִ֖יק עַד־ לְמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the angle in the wall, and he fortified them.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem.
He built a tower at the Corner Gate.
He built a tower at the Valley Gate.
He built a tower at the angle in the wall.
Uzziah made these towers strong.
He fortified them.
passages.original: וַיִּ֨בֶן עֻזִּיָּ֤הוּ מִגְדָּלִים֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַל־ שַׁ֧עַר הַפִּנָּ֛ה וְעַל־ שַׁ֥עַר הַגַּ֖יְא וְעַל־ הַמִּקְצ֑וֹעַ וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽם׃

passages.text: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns. And since he was a lover of the soil, he had farmers and vinedressers in the hill country and in the fertile fields.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
Uzziah had much livestock.
His livestock lived in the foothills and in the plain.
Uzziah built towers in the desert.
He dug many cisterns in the desert.
Uzziah loved the soil.
He had farmers in the hill country.
He had vinedressers in the hill country.
He had farmers in the fertile fields.
He had vinedressers in the fertile fields.
passages.original: וַיִּ֨בֶן מִגְדָּלִ֜ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיַּחְצֹב֙ בֹּר֣וֹת רַבִּ֔ים כִּ֤י מִקְנֶה־ רַּב֙ הָ֣יָה ל֔וֹ וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּבַמִּישׁ֑וֹר אִכָּרִ֣ים וְכֹֽרְמִ֗ים בֶּהָרִים֙ וּבַכַּרְמֶ֔ל כִּֽי־ אֹהֵ֥ב אֲדָמָ֖ה הָיָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Uzziah had an army ready for battle that went out to war by assigned divisions, as recorded by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officers.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
Uzziah had an army.
The army was ready for battle.
The army went out to war in assigned divisions.
Jeiel was the scribe.
Jeiel recorded the divisions.
Maaseiah was an officer.
Maaseiah also recorded the divisions.
Hananiah was one of the king’s royal officers.
Hananiah directed Jeiel and Maaseiah.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י לְעֻזִּיָּ֡הוּ חַיִל֩ עֹשֵׂ֨ה מִלְחָמָ֜ה יוֹצְאֵ֧י צָבָ֣א לִגְד֗וּד בְּמִסְפַּר֙ פְּקֻדָּתָ֔ם בְּיַד֙ יְעוּאֵל הַסּוֹפֵ֔ר וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ הַשּׁוֹטֵ֑ר עַ֚ל יַד־ חֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ מִשָּׂרֵ֖י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: The total number of family leaders of the mighty men of valor was 2,600.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
He had an army of mighty men.
These men were strong and brave.
There were leaders over these men.
These leaders were heads of families.
The total number of these family leaders was 2,600.
passages.original: כֹּ֠ל מִסְפַּ֞ר רָאשֵׁ֤י הָאָבוֹת֙ לְגִבּ֣וֹרֵי חָ֔יִל אַלְפַּ֖יִם וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Under their authority was an army of 307,500 trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
He had an army.
The army had 307,500 soldiers.
These soldiers trained for war.
They were a powerful force.
They served under the leaders of the mighty men.
They helped the king fight his enemies.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יָדָם֩ חֵ֨יל צָבָ֜א שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֗לֶף וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת עוֹשֵׂ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּכֹ֣חַ חָ֑יִל לַעְזֹ֥ר לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל־ הָאוֹיֵֽב׃

passages.text: Uzziah supplied the entire army with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and slingstones.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was the king.
He supplied the entire army.
He gave them shields.
He gave them spears.
He gave them helmets.
He gave them armor.
He gave them bows.
He gave them slingstones.
passages.original: וַיָּכֶן֩ לָהֶ֨ם עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ לְכָל־ הַצָּבָ֗א מָגִנִּ֤ים וּרְמָחִים֙ וְכ֣וֹבָעִ֔ים וְשִׁרְיֹנ֖וֹת וּקְשָׁת֑וֹת וּלְאַבְנֵ֖י קְלָעִֽים׃

passages.text: And in Jerusalem he made skillfully designed devices to shoot arrows and catapult large stones from the towers and corners. So his fame spread far and wide, for he was helped tremendously so that he became powerful.
passages.sermon:
King Uzziah ruled in Jerusalem.
He made devices in Jerusalem.
He designed these devices with great skill.
He placed the devices on the towers and corners of the city.
These devices could shoot arrows.
These devices could also throw large stones.
People heard about Uzziah in distant places.
Uzziah became famous.
God helped Uzziah greatly.
Uzziah became very powerful.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ׀ בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם חִשְּׁבֹנ֜וֹת מַחֲשֶׁ֣בֶת חוֹשֵׁ֗ב לִהְי֤וֹת עַל־ הַמִּגְדָּלִים֙ וְעַל־ הַפִּנּ֔וֹת לִירוֹא֙ בַּֽחִצִּ֔ים וּבָאֲבָנִ֖ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ עַד־ לְמֵ֣רָח֔וֹק כִּֽי־ הִפְלִ֥יא לְהֵעָזֵ֖ר עַ֥ד כִּֽי־ חָזָֽק׃

passages.text: But when Uzziah grew powerful, his arrogance led to his own destruction. He was unfaithful to the LORD his God, for he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
Uzziah became very powerful.
His heart became proud.
His pride led to his downfall.
Uzziah was unfaithful to the LORD his God.
He entered the temple of the LORD.
He went in to burn incense on the altar of incense.
passages.original: וּכְחֶזְקָת֗וֹ גָּבַ֤הּ לִבּוֹ֙ עַד־ לְהַשְׁחִ֔ית וַיִּמְעַ֖ל בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לְהַקְטִ֖יר עַל־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃

passages.text: Then Azariah the priest, along with eighty brave priests of the LORD, went in after him.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was a priest.
Eighty priests of the LORD were with him.
These priests were brave men.
Azariah and the eighty priests went in after Uzziah.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אַחֲרָ֖יו עֲזַרְיָ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְעִמּ֞וֹ כֹּהֲנִ֧ים׀ לַיהוָ֛ה שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים בְּנֵי־ חָֽיִל׃

passages.text: They took their stand against King Uzziah and said, “Uzziah, you have no right to offer incense to the LORD. Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have acted unfaithfully; you will not receive honor from the LORD God.”
passages.sermon:
Azariah the chief priest and eighty brave priests of the LORD confronted King Uzziah.
They stood against King Uzziah.
They spoke directly to him.
They said, “Uzziah, you do not have the right to offer incense to the LORD.
Only the priests can offer incense.
These priests are the descendants of Aaron.
God has set them apart for this work.
Leave the sanctuary now.
You have been unfaithful to God.
You will not receive honor from the LORD God.”
passages.original: וַיַּעַמְד֞וּ עַל־ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לוֹ֙ לֹא־ לְךָ֣ עֻזִּיָּ֗הוּ לְהַקְטִיר֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֣י לַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים בְּנֵי־ אַהֲרֹ֛ן הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לְהַקְטִ֑יר צֵ֤א מִן־ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ כִּ֣י מָעַ֔לְתָּ וְלֹֽא־ לְךָ֥ לְכָב֖וֹד מֵיְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Uzziah, with a censer in his hand to offer incense, was enraged. But while he raged against the priests in their presence in the house of the LORD before the altar of incense, leprosy broke out on his forehead.
passages.sermon:
King Uzziah stood in the house of the LORD.
He held a censer in his hand.
He wanted to offer incense.
Uzziah became very angry.
He raged against the priests.
The priests stood before him at the altar of incense.
Suddenly, leprosy appeared on Uzziah’s forehead.
This happened in front of the priests.
This happened in the house of the LORD.
This happened near the altar of incense.
passages.original: וַיִּזְעַף֙ עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וּבְיָד֥וֹ מִקְטֶ֖רֶת לְהַקְטִ֑יר וּבְזַעְפּ֣וֹ עִם־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְ֠הַצָּרַעַת זָרְחָ֨ה בְמִצְח֜וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל לְמִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃

passages.text: When Azariah the chief priest and all the priests turned to him and saw his leprous forehead, they rushed him out. Indeed, he himself hurried to get out, because the LORD had afflicted him.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was the chief priest.
All the priests were with him.
They turned to King Uzziah.
They saw that leprosy had broken out on his forehead.
They rushed Uzziah out of the sanctuary.
Uzziah also hurried to leave.
The LORD had afflicted Uzziah with leprosy.
passages.original: וַיִּ֣פֶן אֵלָ֡יו עֲזַרְיָהוּ֩ כֹהֵ֨ן הָרֹ֜אשׁ וְכָל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְהִנֵּה־ ה֤וּא מְצֹרָע֙ בְּמִצְח֔וֹ וַיַּבְהִל֖וּהוּ מִשָּׁ֑ם וְגַם־ הוּא֙ נִדְחַ֣ף לָצֵ֔את כִּ֥י נִגְּע֖וֹ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So King Uzziah was a leper until the day of his death. He lived in isolation, leprous and cut off from the house of the LORD, while his son Jotham had charge of the royal palace to govern the people of the land.
passages.sermon:
King Uzziah became a leper.
He remained a leper until he died.
He lived in a separate house.
He was leprous and isolated.
He was cut off from the house of the LORD.
Jotham was Uzziah’s son.
Jotham took charge of the royal palace.
Jotham governed the people of the land.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ עֻזִּיָּ֨הוּ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ מְצֹרָ֣ע׀ עַד־ י֣וֹם מוֹת֗וֹ וַיֵּ֜שֶׁב בֵּ֤ית הַחָפְשׁוּת מְצֹרָ֔ע כִּ֥י נִגְזַ֖ר מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְיוֹתָ֤ם בְּנוֹ֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֖ט אֶת־ עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Uzziah, from beginning to end, they are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Isaiah was the son of Amoz.
Isaiah was a prophet.
Isaiah wrote about King Uzziah.
Isaiah recorded all the acts of Uzziah.
Isaiah wrote about Uzziah’s early deeds.
Isaiah wrote about Uzziah’s later deeds.
Isaiah recorded everything from the beginning to the end of Uzziah’s life.
passages.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאֲחֲרֹנִ֑ים כָּתַ֛ב יְשַֽׁעְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֖וֹץ הַנָּבִֽיא׃

passages.text: And Uzziah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in a field of burial that belonged to the kings; for the people said, “He was a leper.” And his son Jotham reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Uzziah was king of Judah.
Uzziah died.
People buried Uzziah near his ancestors.
They buried him in a burial field that belonged to the kings.
The people said, "He was a leper."
Jotham was Uzziah’s son.
Jotham became king after Uzziah.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָיו֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֤ה הַקְּבוּרָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַמְּלָכִ֔ים כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ מְצוֹרָ֣ע ה֑וּא וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
